The standard tire sizes are derived from available specs sheets and operator documentation from sources, however, exact tire setups can vary based on options (such as G2 vs G3, urban vs off-road).

researchMetadata.fleetEdgeCaseNotes: Lenco BearCats are built on heavily modified Ford F-550 commercial chassis to support extreme armor weight. While a stock F-550 often uses 225/70R19.5, the standard BearCat typically upgrades to 245/70R19.5 run-flat tires. Depending on the variant (e.g., G3 off-road or heavier duty configurations), they may be outfitted with larger military-style 12R20 or 365/80R20 tires. Nearly all are equipped with Hutchinson run-flat inserts, and some feature Central Tire Inflation Systems (CTIS). Treads and sizes can vary based on individual agency orders.
researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: Data was cross-referenced across multiple military and armored vehicle specification databases. Due to the highly customized nature of tactical vehicles, there is no single 'standard' size, but 245/70R19.5 is the most common baseline size for the standard BearCat on an F-550 chassis.

researchMetadata.fleetEdgeCaseNotes: Often upfitted for motorhomes, ambulances, or shuttle buses which may result in aftermarket upsizing to LT245/75R16, 215/85R16, or 235/85R16 for increased load capacity. Must use Load Range E tires due to vehicle GVWR.
researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: Verified through wheel-size.com and cross-referenced with RV/fleet community consensus. The E-450 is a heavy-duty cutaway chassis predominantly using a DRW setup which requires identical sizes (LT225/75R16) with Load Range E on all six positions.

researchMetadata.fleetEdgeCaseNotes: The standard Single Rear Wheel (SRW) base/fleet XL trim comes with LT265/70R17 (or LT275/70R18 as an option). However, Dual Rear Wheel (DRW / Dually) models are extremely common in the F-350 fleet and typically use LT245/75R17 tires. All configurations use a square setup (same tire size on front and rear axles).
researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: Multiple authoritative tire sizing websites (wheel-size.com, tiresize.com, discounttire.com) independently verify that the base SRW 2008 F-350 XL 4x4 uses LT265/70R17 standard, with LT245/75R17 for the DRW models. The information is consistent and reliable.

researchMetadata.fleetEdgeCaseNotes: Police Responder trims use LT265/70R18 pursuit-rated tires. 4WD and Heavy Duty Payload packages often upgrade to 265/70R17 or 265/60R18 sizes.
researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: Verified across multiple tire and wheel sizing databases (wheel-size.com, tiresize.com) that the standard base/fleet XL model size is 245/70R17.

researchMetadata.fleetEdgeCaseNotes: The base Sport trim is equipped with a square 245/75R17 setup. Note that higher trims use different sizes (e.g., Sahara with 255/70R18 and Rubicon with 285/70R17). Staggered setups are not used on factory Jeep Wranglers.
researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: Wheel-size.com is a well-established and highly reliable database for OEM tire and wheel specifications. It accurately distinguishes between different trims, including the base Sport trim which uses 245/75R17 tires.

researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: High confidence; data is consistent across multiple highly reputable tire fitment databases (wheel-size.com, tiresize.com, simpletire.com).

researchMetadata.reliabilityRationale: Information verified across multiple sources, including wheel-size.com and tire retailers like Discount Tire and Firestone, which consistently confirm LT245/75R17 for the 2014 F-350 Super Duty base (XL) trim.
